Selection barriers

Why a polished portfolio is not sufficient evidence

A project can feature a famous client brand without explaining what the agency actually delivered. AI answers require reliable links between the buyer's task, the service and the attributable work.

01

Different disciplines are bundled

Naming, brand platform, packaging design, media planning and performance marketing do not produce the same deliverable. A full-service claim needs service-specific evidence.

02

Metrics have no comparable baseline

Reach, leads, conversion and commercial return answer different questions. Figures without a period, budget, attribution method or agency responsibility may mislead buyers.

03

Client work is over-attributed

Subcontracting, a pitch proposal and running a complete campaign are different roles. Portfolio presentation needs correct permission and clear contribution.

Verifiable facts

Evidence behind an agency recommendation

I verify original project materials, the right to reference client brands and the provider's actual role. Article 18.1 of Russian Advertising Law 38-FZ covers online advertising reporting and labelling when its conditions apply; it does not establish a campaign's effectiveness.

  • Service and deliverable: brand platform, identity, research, creative production, media or ad management
  • Permissioned portfolio examples, baseline, dates, budget context and attribution boundaries
  • Named specialists, authored methodology, acceptance criteria, use rights and applicable advertising responsibilities

This is a sector-specific GEO method, not a claim of measured GAEO results for marketing agency clients.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Should branding and performance marketing have separate pages?+

Yes, when both are genuine services. Buyer expectations and proof differ, so they benefit from distinct descriptions and examples.

Can an agency publish a client's logo?+

Check the contract, permissions and applicable rights first. Participation in a project does not automatically permit promotional use.

Are leads a universal branding-success metric?+

No. Brand, design and advertising projects use different measures and timescales. Commercial attribution requires a documented method.

Does online advertising labelling apply to every expert article?+

It depends on whether the actual placement qualifies as advertising under applicable rules. Do not assume all expert writing is advertising or exempt.

How does GAEO price marketing-agency GEO?+

Published GAEO plans apply. Scope depends on real service lines, specialist profiles, industries and baseline prompts.
